depth_justification: Strong app-specific engagement (ISIC 2020, EfficientNet-B4, Platt scaling, Fitzpatrick type, 5-year pseudonymized retention) with mostly-correct precise citations (GDPR Art. 9(2)(a), 5(1)(e), Chapter V/Art. 46, MDR Art. 61, French HDS), but it fixates/loops on P2.D3 for ~10 turns, uses fabricated dimension IDs (P1.C1, P2.D3, P3.A3) and a leaked </think> tag, and misses the core fairness/skin-tone-bias and automation-bias risks for a CNN triage tool.
actionability_justification: Several concrete, implementable steps with specificity: host health data on a named HDS-certified provider (with the official list URL), SCCs plus supplementary measures (encryption/pseudonymization), a Clinical Evaluation Report under MDR Art. 61, and irreversible pseudonymization checks; weakened only by the AI-Act references staying directional.
